entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Diablo 3D candidate item modeling turnaround sheet, not a runtime icon.
Subject: ONE Bastard Sword, productionId item.design.base.bastard-sword, ICURS_BASTARD_SWORD 57. Use the attached PRIVATE ORIGINAL INVENTORY SPRITE ONLY as silhouette, proportion and material-color reference. Preserve its unusual actual design rather than a generic bastard sword: very long narrow straight silver steel blade with needle-like elongated point; a thicker angular stepped steel collar/ricasso at the blade root with small lateral shoulders; a compact dark cobalt-blue curved oval crossguard enclosing a shallow open oval on each side; dark wine-red leather grip; small warm brass/gold disc pommel. Keep the blue guard/red grip/silver blade/gold pommel distinction. The modest stepped steel details near the blade root must remain subordinate, not become huge spikes or a broad serrated blade.
Produce one coherent high-detail technical concept sheet with FRONT, SIDE thickness, BACK and THREE-QUARTER views of the EXACT SAME sword plus a small NEW detailed HD rendered inventory thumbnail blade up. Entire object visible in every view, spaced cleanly. All views agree on blade silhouette, guard loops, grip and proportions. Hidden rear surfaces, three-dimensional guard and blade cross-section are conservative inferred reconstruction, kept simple.
Restrained realistic dark medieval worn steel, dark blue patinated metal guard, red-brown leather wrapping and modest brass pommel. Neutral soft white studio illumination, no magic/self-emission or colored light; opaque plain charcoal gray backdrop, minimal shadows. Labels only BASTARD SWORD / FRONT / SIDE / BACK / 3-4 / ICON. Never copy, paste, trace or show pixel-art in the sheet or thumbnail; the inset is a fresh HD render of this concept. No characters, hands, scenery, jewels, skulls, extra objects or watermark.

entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Diablo 3D candidate modeling turnaround, NOT a finished runtime icon.
Input image 1: PRIVATE original pixel-art silhouette and color reference for ONE item, Great Sword, item.design.base.great-sword, ICURS_GREAT_SWORD 134. Use it only to inform wholly NEW detailed concept art; never paste its pixels or reproduce a pixel-art inset. Input image 2: layout, clean neutral rendering and presentation style reference ONLY (Claymore board); do not borrow its sword geometry.
Create a clean high-detail realistic game-prop concept sheet showing the exact SAME SINGLE physical object in FRONT flat face, true SIDE thickness, BACK opposite face, and THREE-QUARTER views, plus a smaller NEW HD rendered inventory-composition thumbnail of that same concept. Whole isolated vertical objects, widely spaced; plain charcoal-gray background, neutral soft studio light, restrained finely worn real steel, brass/copper and leather. Labels only GREAT SWORD / FRONT / SIDE / BACK / 3-4 / ICON, understated light serif typography. Keep the complete blade tips, guards and pommels in frame.
Crucial reference fidelity: despite its name GREAT SWORD, the source blade is CURVED and comparatively slim, not a straight double-edged claymore. Preserve the long gently sweeping silver-gray single-edged blade, the asymmetric curved outline, relatively narrow width, and the subtly clipped/rounded upper tip visible in the reference rather than inventing a symmetric spear point. The steel blade is much longer than the grip. At its base retain a small warm brass collar and the distinctive dark copper/rust-brown asymmetric curling guard with swept branching quillons, then the visibly crimson/dark red long grip and small muted gold/brass endcap. Preserve the original palette distribution: silver blade, dark orange-brown guard, red grip, small brass accents. For this candidate infer real forged metal and red leather surfaces; unseen thickness/back and the exact guard construction are reconstructions. Do not straighten the blade to suit the item name, do not exaggerate it into a broad falchion/scimitar, and do not replace the curled guard with the Claymore's straight crossguard.
All views must have identical grip length, tip shape, blade curvature, guard topology and material placement. BACK is the opposite face of the same asymmetric object, so its projected curvature reverses naturally; it is not a second design. SIDE shows the thin blade thickness rather than another full-width face. The small ICON is a newly rendered high-detail view of this same curved sword, never the input sprite.
Avoid alternate variants, hands, people, scenery, fire/glow, neon, fantasy jewels/skulls/spikes, added runes, baked dramatic shadows, colored lights, source pixel-art, collage or generic straight greatsword. Sharp readable silhouette and restrained real material detail, matching the existing clean board language.

reference.notes: Referência 6x inspecionada antes da geração. Apesar do nome Great Sword, a imagem mostra lâmina comprida e curva, aço cinza, guarda sinuosa castanho-alaranjada, cabo vermelho e pequenos acentos dourados.

inferredAreas: Espessura, face posterior, construção dos ramos curvos da guarda e detalhes de fixação são reconstruções.
Os quillons em forma de fita torcida e o corte/recorte da ponta são soluções propostas pelo conceito; a referência de baixa resolução não comprova essas construções.
Leituras de aço, couro vermelho, cobre e latão são propostas a partir das cores; desgaste fino e detalhes do pomo não foram recuperados do sprite.

coherenceReview.observed: A prancha preserva lâmina curva relativamente estreita, paleta cinza/vermelho/castanho-alaranjado/dourado e guarda sinuosa, sem converter o item numa espada reta genérica. Todas as vistas estão presentes; o thumbnail é novo HD.
pendingIssues: BACK mantém o sentido projetado da curvatura de FRONT enquanto espelha a guarda; a face oposta deveria ser reconciliada para representar a mesma lâmina assimétrica.
Revisar orientação da curva em 3-4 e a ligação entre lâmina, guarda e cabo em todas as vistas antes do master 3D.
Reconciliar espessura, grip e espaço útil para as mãos com a frente de personagens antes da modelagem; nenhum socket ou encaixe foi validado nesta imagem.
A ponta ficou mais afilada que a leitura arredondada/oblíqua da referência; confirmar o perfil antes de selecionar o conceito.
A construção tridimensional dos ramos da guarda é inferida e deve ser revisada com a referência; não tratar o detalhe gerado como fidelidade comprovada.

No individually generated unique art or approved geometry reuse is claimed; stats, powers and profile/table identity remain native and separate. The shared Great Sword study is incomplete; asymmetric BACK/guard coherence blocks master production for this identity as well.
